newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia tenders $57.51 million in T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia tenders $57.51 million in T-bills.

text.p: The central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) tendered on Wednesday for treasury bills valued at 390 million birr ($57.51 million).
The bills are for 28-day, 91-day and 182-day categories and will be issued on July 16,1997.
The amount tendered were 200 million birr for 28-day bills maturing on August 13, 140 million birr maturing on October 15, and 50 million birr maturing on Janurary 14, 1998.
The bank said it should receive tenders not later than July 14, adding that auction results would be announced on July 16.
